description.value:
You've heard time and time again that a Starfinder needs to be knowledgeable, skilled, and personable—traits you've never had in abundance. But you didn't let that stop you from becoming a Starfinder! You've got what you consider to be the most important trait of all: defiant persistence! You don't let naysayers, bigwigs, or your own personal failings stop you from achieving your goals, just like you don't let a little blood, sweat, or tears keep you down. You know when push comes to shove, you can take the hits, and just keep coming. Failure isn't in your vocabulary!

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Labor Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Toughness] feat.
